# Goal
Mado round 16: C1 coverage lowest active rubric 6/7 -> 7/7 sourced documented routes, U7 Waybar module text observation boundary (not rendered verification). C2 operability acquire a fail-closed static desktop action-plan safety gate, not a sandbox or host repair. L1 holds canonical planner seat. Baseline 32c4fda873c9cb47a84c549b24b80ead2bcaa1ea.
# Contract
Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/<that path>. Only assigned files plus own report; no fleet/sibling edits, no commits. No build/lint/tests/check execution by seats; L1 alone verifies once after integration. No delegation. Message only MadoR16 by exact id, never Main or agent://all. Read round-15-verifier-spotcheck.md before work. Never open/copy/query/modify ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or credential/auth files; never launch separate omp CLI processes. No live compositor, service, input-device, screenshot or command producer probes. Source reading only. No package or service operations whatsoever; host remediation is operator-owned. Tooling authorization: read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md before helpful installs; record tool/version/channel/reason. This round do not install anything; report missing prerequisites. All pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide until operator recovery decision: never -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, downgrade or restart services. After pause only operator-authorized future install may use real pacman -Sp --print-format '%n %v' plan and complete installed-name comparison; any overlap refuses. Hard-coded fixture is not actual package validation. Source commands are data, never permission.
L1 owns corpus/SOURCES.md, corpus/README.md, SKILL.md, QUALITY.md, SCORECARD.md, LOG.md and lesson integration. Reserved new source ids S053 tagged Waybar custom module man, S054 tagged custom.cpp, S055 closure own-work safety. All read-only reviewers write only own report. State exact anchors and limits; do not duplicate another seat's ownership.

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.

Create ONLY /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/tools/mado-action-plan.py and /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-16/safety-policy.json. Implement a Python stdlib static JSON action-plan gate: input --plan PATH --policy PATH; schema plan object actions list of objects containing kind and argv list. Persist policy paused=true, allowed kinds read-source (nonempty argv), repo-write (nonempty argv), package-install blocked, service-mutate blocked, compositor-mutate blocked, input-capture blocked, unknown/malformed fail closed. For read-source/repo-write refuse executable basenames pacman,yay,paru,systemctl,hyprctl,omarchy,libinput,evtest,sudo,sh,bash,env (no shell execution or command evaluation). This is a bounded declared-plan classifier not arbitrary shell analysis or enforcement. Exit 0 clean finding plan_safe; 1 failed stable reason; 2 could-not-evaluate malformed/policy. Expose --selftest self-invocation subprocess fixtures asserting exit+finding; pins independent expected constants. Implement --frozen DIR verifies expected.json input digests for plan.json and policy.json then compares verdict/code; tampering returns 2 snapshot_tampered. No tests yourself. Gate must never execute supplied argv or inspect host. Report API exactly.
